description: Project scaffolding - Set up the monorepo structure with all dependencies, configuration files, database schema, and development tooling. This establishes the complete foundation for the application.
steps: Create root package.json with npm workspaces pointing to packages/frontend, packages/backend, and packages/shared

Create packages/shared/package.json and packages/shared/src/types.ts with shared TypeScript interfaces: User, Period, Subject, CompositeSubject, SubjectComponent, Grade, and API request/response types
Create packages/backend/package.json with dependencies: express, @prisma/client, prisma, bcryptjs, jsonwebtoken, cors, dotenv, zod. DevDeps: typescript, @types/*, vitest, tsx
Create packages/backend/tsconfig.json targeting ES2020 with strict mode

Create packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma with PostgreSQL provider and models: User (id, username, passwordHash, createdAt), Period (id, name, userId, createdAt), Subject (id, name, periodId, isComposite, finalGrade), SubjectComponent (id, subjectId, name, weightPercentage), Grade (id, subjectComponentId, name, value, weightPercentage, order)
Create packages/backend/src/index.ts with Express server setup, CORS, JSON parsing, and route registration
Create packages/backend/.env.example with DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, PORT placeholders

Create packages/frontend/package.json with dependencies: react, react-dom, react-router-dom, axios, @headlessui/react, react-hot-toast, lucide-react. DevDeps: vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, typescript, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, vitest, @testing-library/react, jsdom
Create packages/frontend/vite.config.ts with React plugin and proxy to backend API

Create packages/frontend/tailwind.config.ts with custom pastel pink/purple color palette (primary: rose/pink shades, secondary: purple/violet shades, accent: lavender), dark mode set to 'class' strategy, and custom font configuration
Create packages/frontend/postcss.config.js with tailwindcss and autoprefixer
Create packages/frontend/tsconfig.json with path aliases (@/ pointing to src/)
Create packages/frontend/src/main.tsx with React DOM render and App import
Create packages/frontend/src/App.tsx with React Router setup and AuthProvider wrapper
Create docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL 16 service configured for local development
Create root .gitignore for node_modules, dist, .env, and database files
Create root .env.example with all required environment variables documented
acceptance_criteria: Running npm install at root succeeds and installs all workspace dependencies
Running npm run build compiles both frontend and backend without TypeScript errors
Prisma schema validates with npx prisma validate
Docker compose can start PostgreSQL container
Tailwind config includes custom pastel pink/purple color palette with dark mode support
Shared types package exports all necessary interfaces
verification: Run npm install and confirm no errors
Run npm run build and confirm both packages compile
Confirm tailwind.config.ts has custom color palette and darkMode: 'class'
findings: Node.js v20.20.2 available at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin. Must export PATH with this prefix for all npm/node commands. Prisma validate requires DATABASE_URL env var. vitest needs --passWithNoTests flag when no test files exist. tsconfig.tsbuildinfo generated during frontend build and should be committed.
